qa_pairs.question: Which vehicle types does the lever to pedal value sender specification apply to?
What section of the manual covers these sender specifications?
qa_pairs.answer: 12 - 16 Engine Electrical System, subsection 12 72 Senders for Control Unit

qa_pairs.question: What unit of measurement is used for both sender torque specifications?
How many different sender components are listed in this torque specification table?
What is the difference in torque specification between the two sender components?
qa_pairs.answer: 4 Nm (9 Nm for 1AZ minus 5 Nm for 2AZ)

qa_pairs.question: Which sender component has the higher torque specification?
qa_pairs.answer: The lever to pedal value sender (1AZ) with 9 Nm
